kashika: विभाषेत्ययमधिकारो वेदितव्यः। यदित ऊर्ध्वमनुक्रमिष्यामः, तद् विभाषा भवति। वक्ष्यति — <<अपपरिबहिरञ्चवः पञ्चम्या>> [[२.१.१२]] — अपत्रिगर्तं वृष्टो देवः। अप त्रिगर्तेभ्यः॥
kashikaEnglish: From here on, compounds are optional (विभाषा). The same meaning can be expressed without compounding.
englishShort: All the समासाः that are told henceforth (in the following sutras) happen optionally.
englishFull:
The word विभाषा "optionally" governs all subsequent sūtras.

This अधिकार makes the following compound rules optional. The same meaning can be expressed either:
- By the compound, or
- By the uncompounded phrase

**Contrast with earlier rules:** Compounds like सुमद्रम्, यथाबद्धम्, अक्षपरि are नित्य (invariable) — their meaning cannot be expressed without compounding.
